$comment: Packaged-test coverage for every menu item and keyboard shortcut (L6). Status: exercised = the packaged spec drives the action; reachable = the packaged spec shows the item; open = no packaged test yet. Every non-open entry names a spec under tests/desktop whose text must contain the evidence string. Strict release mode (JOY_MEDIA_L6_RELEASE=1) fails while any entry is open.
